tei:div.tei:p: "!#༁ྃ: bi ma'i bla sgrub lam zab snying po las: yang gsang mkha' 'gro'i phrin las gud du sbas pa bzhugs so:

ḍā ki siṃ ha mu kha la phyag 'tshal lo: yang gsang kun tu bzang mo gnam zhal dbyings kyi dbang phyug ma drag tu khros pa ye shes kyi ḍā ki seng gdong ma'i phrin las zab mo gud du sbas pa la gsum: bsnyen pa: sgrub pa: las sbyor ro: dang po ni: phyi nang gsang sgrub sngon du song nas: bdag nyid skad cig gis che mchog yab yum drag mo seng gdong can du gnas bsgyur ba'am: 'di nyid zur du bsgom na tshogs gsag dang mchod pa byin brlab sngon du 'gro bas: hūm̐ bh+yo: ma skyes rang byung 'od gsal dbyings kyi ngang: rig pa ye shes kun bzang gnam zhal ma: drag tu khros pa bdud 'dul seng ge'i gdong: nam mkha'i mdog can gar dgu'i nyams dang ldan: phyag g.yas gri gug gzung 'dzin drwa ba gcod: g.yon pas thod khrag bde chen ye shes 'bar: he ru ka dpal kha ṭ+wāṃ mchan g.yon bzung: rin chen rus rgyan dar dpyang cod pan 'phur: sku smad gnam lcags phur bu me 'bar bas: pad+ma nyi zla bdud bzhi'i snying khar gzir: phur pa'i dbal las me rlung 'khrugs pa'i klong: bde gshegs rin chen pad+ma las mkha' 'gro: dkar ser dmar ljang rigs kyi gtso mor bzhengs: de las phra men dbang phyug sgo ma'i tshogs: bsam gyis mi khyab nyi zer rdul ltar 'phro: snod bcud dag pa seng gdong mkha' 'gro'i dal: sku gsung thugs mchog gdod nas rdo rje gsum: dug lnga gnas gyur ye shes rnam pa lnga: sku lnga ye rdzogs chen por dbang bskur ro: oṃ āḥhūm̐ oṃ hūm̐ trāṃ hrī ā: hūm̐ bh+yo: kun tu bzang mo gnam zhal dbyings phyug ma: drag tu khros pa ḍā ki seng ge'i gdong: 'bum phrag mkha' 'gro phra men tshogs dang bcas: bar chad bdud tshogs 'dul phyir dbyings nas bzhengs: oṃ badz+ra ḍā ki siṃ ha mu kha sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra sa ma ya dza dza: dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho: a ti pū ho: pra tīts+tsha ho: phyi nang gsang bas mchod cing bstod pa ni: hūm̐ bh+yo:

gnam zhal dbyings phyug rab khros seng ge'i gdong: sangs rgyas phrin las rdzogs mdzad kī la ya: bde gshegs rin chen pad+ma las mkha' 'gro: ma mo 'bum gyi tshogs dang bcas la bstod: bzlas pa bya ba ni: thugs kar sbas pa'i yab ya ma rā tsa'i ngo bo gnam lcags kyi rdo rje rtse dgu rwa gdengs shing me 'bar ba'i lte bar nyi ma la gnas pa'i hūm̐ yig gi mthar sngags kyi phreng bas bskor ba las 'od zer 'phros: ma rungs pa'i gdug pa can thams cad tshar bcad: rtsa gsum chos skyong srung ma'i byin rlabs dang nus stobs thams cad rang la thim pas lha sngags ye shes kyi gzi byin ches cher 'bar bar bsam la: oṃ badz+ra kro dhī shwa rī siṃ ha mu kha hūm̐ phaṭa: 'bum phrag bdun sogs ci rigs par bzla ba ni bsnyen pa'o: gnyis pa sgrub pa niḥ hūm̐ yig gi mthar sgrub pa'i sngags kyi phreng bas bskor ba las 'od zer 'phros: snod bcud kyi dngos 'dzin thams cad bsregs shing sbyangs: snang grags rtog tshogs dbyings phyug ḍā ki seng gdong ma'i sku gsung thugs kyi phyag rgyar sad par bsam la: aḥkaḥsaḥmaḥraḥtsaḥshaḥdaḥraḥsaḥmaḥraḥyaḥphaṭa: ces 'bum phrag bzhi bzla'o: gsum pa las sbyor la spyi dang bye brag gnyis las: dang po ni: thugs ka'i sngags phreng las 'od zer dkar po 'phros: bud+dha seng gdong ma'i thugs rgyud bskul: de las 'od zer dkar po'i tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'phros pas mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad zhi: tshur 'dus 'od dkar po'i gur du gyur par bsam la: sgrub sngags sham du: ha bud+dha siṃ ha mu kha oṃ shān+tiṃ ku ru swā hā: btags pa bzla: de bzhin du: 'od zer ser pos rin chen seng gdong ma'i rgyud bskul: rgyas pa'i las thams cad bsgrubs: tshur 'dus 'od dkar po'i gur gyi phyi rol du 'od ser po'i gur du gyur par bsam la: ri rat+na siṃ ha mu kha bh+rūm̐ puṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru oṃ: dmar pos pad+ma seng gdong ma'i rgyud bskul:

snang sems dbang du bsdus: tshur 'dus 'od dmar po'i gur du gyur par bsam la: ni pad+ma siṃ ha mu kha hrīḥwā shaṅku ru ho: mthing gas las kyi seng gdong ma'i rgyud bskul: mi mthun pa thams cad tshar bcad: tshur 'dus 'od mthing ga'i gur du gyur par bsam la: sa karma siṃ ha mu kha hūm̐ mā ra ya phaṭa: 'od zer sna tshogs pas gtso 'khor thams cad kyi rgyud bskul: phrin las rnam bzhi lhun gyis grub: tshur 'dus 'od sna lnga 'khrugs pa'i gur du gyur par bsam la: baṃ badz+ra siṃ ha mu kha sarba sid+dhi hūm̐ hūm̐: 'od zer ljang gus rtsa gsum rgyal ba rab 'byams kyi thugs rgyud bskul: thugs rje byin rlabs thams cad spyan drangs: 'od ljang gu'i gur du gyur pas las thams cad brtan cing nus pa dang ldan par bsam la: oṃ sarba sid+dhi su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ya swā hā: zhes dang dbyangs gsal rten snying yang bzla'o: gnyis pa bye brag gi las sbyor la gsum las: dang po srung ba ni: rang gi thugs srog las baṃ ha ri ni sa bh+yo zhes pa'i sngags kyi yi ge sgra dang bcas pa 'phros: phyi rol du seng gdong rigs lnga dang phra men brgyad kyi ngo bo rdo rje: 'khor lo: rin chen: pad+ma: ral gri: gnam lcags kyi tsakra rtsibs brgyad pa dang bcas pa'i gur khang yangs shing rgya che ba sra zhing brtan pa: 'khor lo'i rtsibs rtser phra men gyi ḍā ki brgyad 'khor dbang phyug ma mo 'bum gyi tshogs dang bcas te zhal nang du gzigs nas srung ba'i sngags 'brug stong ltar sgrog cing mtshams kyi las mdzad pa'i sku las ye shes kyi me chu rlung gi tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'phros pas byad phur gdon bgegs thams cad phyogs su nye mi nus par bsam: thugs ka'i hūm̐ yig sngags phreng bcas nyi zla kha sbyor srubs med pa'i nang du tshud cing hūm̐ gi khog par rang dang bsrung bya'i gtso bo'i rlung sems dbyer med pa'i ngo bo thig le dkar 'tsher snum la 'dril ba 'od zer kha dog lnga 'phro ba dang:

mtha' skor du bsrung bya gzhan rnams dngos sam ming yig dang po thig les brgyan pa'i rnam par gsal bar bsam ste: sgrub sngags sham du: badz+ra kī li kī la ya e sa bh+yo srungs: zhes gtso bor bzla zhing thun mthar/ e ka ya ma du ru tsakras srungs: he ka ya ma du ru tsakras srungs: ghṛ ma ya ma du ru tsakras srungs: ma ma kā wā tsi rak+ṣa rak+ṣa bh+rūm̐: zhes pa'ang bzla'o: gnyis pa bsad pa ni: las mjug 'phang bas bsdu ba'i dbang du byas te: ma traṃ gyi lte bar zlog dkyil thod rwa dang khrag mtsho'i nang du chos 'byung gru gsum: de'i dbus su 'khor lo rtsibs bzhi lte ba dang bcas pa bri: steng du dug gtor 'khor lo rtsibs bzhi'i dbus dang phyogs bzhir dmar gtor: mthar dmar gtor chung ngu mang po dang khrag kong mtshe yungs skyer rtsang sogs zor rdzas kyis brgyan pa bsham: gzhan yang sman gtor rak+ta drag po'i nyer spyod tshogs gtor sogs 'du bya: dkyil 'khor gyi 'og tu gri lcags sam phung sa'i hom khung mtshan nyid tshang bar liṅga spyi ltar bris pa bcug: bdag bskyed bsnyen sgrub srung dmigs bcas grub nas: mdun gyi gtor ma lhar gsal spyan 'dren mchod bstod bar bya: e las gnam lcags kyi khang sgrom zur gsum pa'i nang du dgra bgegs byad ma dngos su gsal: bdag mdun 'khor gyi phra men dbang phyug ma mo'i tshogs kyis dmigs bya dbang med du bkug bstim lha dang phral: mthu rtsal dang tshe bsod thams cad rang la bstim: gtso mo'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ las sha za phra men ma mo'i tshogs kyi ngo bo bh+yoḥdamar nag gnyis spros pa kha dang bshang lam nas zhugs: snying khar sleb ma thag zangs lcags kyi 'khor lor gyur te g.yon du shugs drag por 'khor bas sha khrag rus gsum dmar myog myog tu gtub cing 'khor gyi ma mo'i tshogs kyis hab thob tu zos par bsam la: sgrub sngags sham du: badz+ra kī li kī la ya e sa bh+yo rbad:

ces dang: e ka ya ma du ru tsakras sod: he ka ya ma= ghṛ ma ya ma= dgra bgegs byad ma mā ra ya thuṃ ril rbad: ces pa'ang bzla: mchod bstod bya: tshogs rdzas raṃ yaṃ khaṃ gis bsang: stong pa'i ngang las tshogs gzhong bhan+dha 'bar ba'i snod du tshogs rdzas bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho 'dod yon gyi sprin phung 'phro bar gyur: oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hrī: hūm̐: 'og min chos dbyings pho brang dang: dur khrod drag po'i gnas mchog nas: bdud 'dul mkha' 'gro seng gdong ma: rigs lnga sprul pa yang sprul dang: phra men ma mo 'bum sde'i tshogs: longs spyod tshogs kyi 'du bar gshegs: oṃ badz+ra siṃ ha mu kha sa pa ri wā ra e h+ye hi: dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho: hūm̐: bla med mchog gi dam tshig rdzas: 'dod yon rgya mtsho'i sprin phung 'phro: tshogs kyi mchod pa dam pa 'di: thugs dam dbang gis bzhes su gsol: sarba ga ṇa tsakra pū dza ho: ho: bdag cag ma rig 'khrul pa yis: ye shes ḍā ki'i lha tshogs kyi: thugs dang 'gal ba'i nyes ltung kun: mthol bshags tshangs pa'i dngos grub stsol: yi ge brgya pa brjod: de ltar mchod bshags sngon du 'gro bas gdab kha'i las bya ba la: thugs dam bskul ba ni: hūm̐ bh+yo: chos dbyings skye med ngang las ma g.yos kyang: skye ba'i cho 'phrul kun bzang gnam zhal yum: drag tu khros pa ḍā ki seng ge'i gdong: rigs lnga phra men ma mo 'bum gyi tshogs: thugs dam bskul lo thugs rje'i mthu rtsal skyed: zhing bcu tshang ba'i dam nyams dgra bo dang: bstan pa bshig pa'i nag phyogs bgegs rigs la: mngon spyod drag po'i phrin las dus la babs: zhes bskul gser skyems byin gyis brlabs pa 'bul zhing: hūm̐: rtsa brgyud bla ma mchog gsum yi dam lha: gser skyems bdud rtsi 'bar ba 'di gsol la: rnal 'byor bdag gi gzu dang dpang mdzod cig: mthu rtsal nus pa'i gzi byin bskyed du gsol: dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos srung dregs pa'i sde:

gser skyems= rnal 'byor= mthu rtsal= phyogs skyong lha klu sa bdag 'byung po'i tshogs: gser skyems= rnal 'byor= mthu rtsal nus pa'i gzi byin bskyed du gsol: de nas liṅga dmigs bya dngos su gsal la bden stobs brjod mthar: sgrub sngags dang: nṛ tri sarba sha trūn ā kar+ṣa ya yaṃ yaṃ dza dza: zhes pas dgug: oṃ badz+ra aṅgu sha dza: badz+ra pā sha hūm̐: badz+ra s+pho ṭa baṃ: badz+ra gan+ḍe ho: zhes pas rten la bcing: gu gul gyis bdug: bya 'ug gi sgros dbye rgya dang bcas: nṛ tri sha trūn sarba de wa shag shag phye phye u tsaṭ+ṭa ya phaṭa: ces lha dang dbye: phyag g.yon thod khrag las nad mtshon dug khrag gi char babs par bsam la: gong gi bsad sngags bzla zhing thun brdeg: sku smad phur pa'i dpal las gnam lcags kyi las phur mtshan nyid rdzogs pa char ltar babs pas tshe bsod rang la 'dus: rnam shes dbyings su spar: lus kyi gnad thams cad gcod par bsam la phur pa 'dril zhing*/ hūm̐ bh+yo: bdud 'dul ḍā ki seng gdong 'khor bcas kyi: phrin las yongs rdzogs badz+ra kī la yas: dgra bgegs gnod byed byad ma'i tshogs rnams la: mngon spyod drag po'i phrin las dus la babs: sgrub sngags dang: badz+ra kī li kī la ya sarba sha trūn hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ a yaṃ mā ra ya rbad: ces gdab: phyag g.yas kyi gri gug las gri gug gi char babs pas snyigs ma'i phung po dum bur gtub par bsam la: sgrub sngags dang: ts+tshin+da ts+tshin+da bhin+dha bhin+dha ha he phaṭ: ces brjod: zan ling gi cha shas gtor mar 'bul zhing: hūm̐ bh+yo: gdug pa'i dgra bgegs bsgral pa'i sha khrag rus: bdud 'dul seng gdong lha tshogs zhal du bstab: rngams shing dgyes pa'i tshul gyis bzhes nas kyang: mngon spyod drag po'i phrin las yongs rdzogs mdzod: oṃ badz+ra siṃ ha mu kha sa pa ri wā ra ma hā māṃ sa rak+ta tsit+ta go ro tsa na ba su ta kiṃ ni ri ti kha kha khā hi khā hi: dgyes pa'i gad mo dang bcas bzhes te mngon spyod kyi las la slar yang spro ba'i tshul gyis bzhugs par bsam mo:

gsum pa bzlog pa la: ting nge 'dzin ni: srung ba'i dmigs pa'i mjug tu: zlog sngags bzlas pas phyi rol gyi phra men ma mo 'bum sde'i tshogs rnams zhal phyir gzigs te sngags kyi sgra 'brug stong ltar sgrog cing: sku las ye shes kyi me rlung chu dang mtshon cha'i tshogs 'phros pas mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad dgra bgegs kyi steng du bzlog par bsam la: sgrub sngags sham du: badz+ra kī li kī la ya e sa bh+yo zlog: ces dang: e ka ya ma du ru tsakras zlog: he ka ya ma du ru= ghṛ ma ya ma= aḥyaḥmaḥduḥruḥtsaḥshaḥnaḥbh+yo bh+yo zlog zlog bh+yo zlog cig: ces bzla: mthar bdag mdun gyi gtso 'khor thams cad kyi phyag gnyis kyi mthil du nyi zla'i dkyil 'khor 'od 'bar ba gsal btab nas brdab pa'i bar du gnod byed thams cad rdul phran bzhin brlags par bsam la: na mo: bla ma mchog gsum rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i tshogs kyi bka' bden pa dang: yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang: ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro seng gdong ma 'khor yang 'khor sprul pa yang sprul gyi tshogs dang bcas pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang: bden pa'i mthus bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa'i nad gdon bar chad byad phur rbod gtong mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad dgra dang bgegs kyi steng du zlog cig: sgyur cig: med par gyur cig: zhi bar gyur cig: rab tu zhi bar gyur cig: zhes dang: gong gi sngags dang: oṃ hūm̐ trika khroṃ bh+yo: ma ni mā ra ṇi bh+yo: mā ra du na bh+yo: rak+mo raka shan bh+yo: ting ya rak+sha bh+yo: ya ma rā tsa bh+yo: mā ra ya kī la ya bh+yo: ces bzlas shing thal mo brdab bo: zlog pa'i las bcol ba ni: bsad las kyi zhal bstab yan grub par byas nas: ling ro dang gtor chung khrag skyems bran pa 'bul zhing bskul ba sngon du 'gro bas: hūm̐ bh+yo: dbus phyogs gsang chen rol pa'i dur khrod nas: me long ye shes rdo rje rigs kyi yum:

zhe sdang bdud 'dul badz+ra seng ge'i gdong: gtso 'khor sprul par bcas pa dbyings nas bzhengs: dgra bgegs sha khrag mchod gtor 'di bzhes la: rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa yi: nad rigs bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi dgra la zlog: gdon rigs sum brgya drug cu dgra la zlog: bgegs rigs stong phrag brgyad cu dgra= glo bur bdun brgya nyi shu dgra= ye 'drog sum brgya drug cu= dus min 'chi ba bco brgyad= 'jigs chen brgyad dang bcu drug= sde brgyad gdug pa'i cho 'phrul= sangs rgyas chos kyi bden tshig= mu stegs gdug pa'i ngan sngags= ban bon sngags pa'i byad phur= mnan sreg 'phang ba'i 'phrul 'khor= gnam gyi 'ju thag chad pa= sa yi rten phur bud pa= bar gyi mtshan ltas ngan pa= chag che nyam nga thams cad= lo skag zla gshed thams cad= mi mthun mi 'dod phyogs kun dgra la zlog: zlog go dmar chen gtor ma 'di yis zlog: sgyur ro byad phur rbod gtong dgra la sgyur: bzlog bsgyur bcol pa'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: hūm̐ bh+yo: shar phyogs khrag 'thung rol pa'i dur khrod nas: chos dbyings ye shes bde gshegs rigs kyi yum: gti mug bdud 'dul bud+dha seng ge'i gdong: gtso 'khor sprul par bcas pa dbyings nas bzhengs: dgra bgegs sha khrag sogs: hūm̐ bh+yo: lho phyogs gshin rje rol pa'i= mnyam nyid ye shes rin chen= nga rgyal bdud 'dul rat+na seng ge'i gdong: gtso 'khor sprul par= dgra bgegs sha khrag sogs: hūm̐ bh+yo: nub phyogs dbang chen rol pa'i= sor rtog ye shes pad+ma= 'dod chags bdud 'dul pad+ma seng ge'i gdong: gtso 'khor sprul par= dgra bgegs sha khrag sogs: hūm̐ bh+yo: byang phyogs phrin las rol pa'i= bya grub ye shes las kyi= phrag dog bdud 'dul karma seng ge'i gdong: gtso 'khor= dgra bgegs sogs: hūm̐ bh+yo: rab 'jigs dur khrod chen po'i gnas brgyad nas: rigs lnga ḍā ki'i bka' nyan las byed gtso:

bar chad bdud 'dul phra men chen mo brgyad: gtso 'khor= dgra bgegs sogs: hūm̐ bh+yo: 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor chen po'i bar khyams nas: legs nyes stangs 'dzin dam tshig rjes gcod ma: dbang phyug chen mo nyi shu rtsa brgyad dang: ma mo 'bum gyi tshogs rnams las la bzhengs: dgra bgegs sogs: hūm̐ bh+yo: gzhan yang dpal chen yab yum bka' sdod cing: drag rtsal thogs med zhing bcu'i dgra bgegs sgrol: lha klu gnod sbyin rgyal po gza' btsan sogs: sde brgyad gdug pa'i dmag dpung las la bzhengs: dgra bgegs sha khrag sogs: mthar zlog sngags drag tu bzla zhing thal mo brdab: thun gtor 'phang ngo: de nas tshogs lhag byin gyis brlab: hūm̐ bh+yo: lhag la dbang ba'i dregs tshogs kun: sha khrag bdud rtsir bcas pa yi: lhag ma'i gtor ma 'di longs la: bcol pa'i phrin las myur du sgrubs: oṃ uts+tshiṣ+ṭa ba liṃ ta kha raṃ khā hi: zhes bsngos shing smon lam gdab: las mjug 'phang bas bsdu ba ni: gtor ma'i lhar mchod cing bstod nas bzod gsol rjes: gtor ma'i ye shes lha tshogs nam mkhar bzhugs: dam tshig pa rnams rang la dbyer med thim: slar yang gtor rdzas bdud 'dul seng ge'i gdong: 'khor bcas dug mtshon char pa 'beb par gyur: zlog sngags mang du bzlas pas bsgrub cing bzlog pa'i las bcol: sgo dbye ba'i phyir gser skyems mchod cing: hūm̐: rtsa brgyud bla ma yi dam lha: khyad par bdud 'dul seng ge'i gdong: gtso 'khor sprul pa yang sprul dang: sgo skyong phra men tshogs bcas kun: gser skyems phud kyi mchod pa bzhes: gtor ma'i zor sgo dgra la phyes: lha klu sa bdag phyogs skyong tshogs: gser skyems bdud rtsi 'di gsol la: sku zur dbu smod zhabs sdus shig: bdag gi grogs dang dpung la gshegs: zor sna dgra dang bgegs la drongs: mngon spyod drag po'i las mdzod cig: sarba bhū ta sa ma ya sma ra rak+ṣan+tu:

zhes dam bsgrags: gtor ma stegs las phab ste skul ba bya: chad tho btang 'phang sar khyer la gser skyems sngon du 'gro bas: hūm̐ bh+yo: nga ni kun tu bzang mo dbyings phyug yum: drag tu khros pa ḍā ki seng ge'i gdong: dus gsum rgyal ba kun gyi phrin las rdzogs: las byed pho nya'i tshogs kyis stong khams khyab: de ring mngon spyod zor gyi las la bzhengs: sdang ba'i dgra dang gnod byed bgegs tshogs la: sde brgyad dregs pa'i tshogs kyis kong zor rgyob: lha klu sa bdag tshogs kyis rdo zor rgyob: ma mo 'bum sde'i tshogs kyis khrag zor= dbang phyug sgo ma'i tshogs kyis dug zor= phra men chen mo brgyad kyis mda' zor= rigs bzhi seng gdong ḍā kis nyungs zor= gtso 'khor sprul par bcas pas gtor zor rgyob: lus ngag yid gsum thal ba'i rdul bzhin rlogs: bdun rgyud rigs kyang rtsad nas brlag par gyis: zlog sngags brjod cing 'phangs pas sprul pa'i dmag tshogs kyis dgra bgegs tshar bcad par bsam: shog ling yod na hom du bsreg: srung sngags bzla zhing srung 'khor bsgom: brtan ma bskyang: gtor gzhong kha sbubs 'og tu dgra bgegs dam sri thams cad mnan par bsam la: hūm̐ bh+yo: bdud 'dul drag mo'i dkyil 'khor du: dbyings phyug khros ma'i rdo rje'i bros: bar chad dam sri 'byung po kun: skye med chos kyi dbyings su mnan: oṃ āḥhūm̐ s+t+waṃ bha ya laṃ nan: zhes bro brdung: nang du log nas mchod bstod bya: sngags mthar/ kā ya wā ka tsit+ta sarba sid+dhi pha la hūm̐: zhes dngos grub blang: nongs pa bshags: ye shes pa gshegs: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ gis bdag nyid lhar gsal ba dbyings su bstim: phaṭa phaṭa phaṭaḥkyis slar yang lha yi skur ldangs la bsngo smon shis brjod rgyas par bya'o: las sbyor de rnams ni so so'i las mthar phyin pa'i bar du bya ba yin no: gzhan yang las phran 'khor los srung ba ni:

ro ras sam gro shog la thal chen dang gri khrag bsres pa'i snag tshas dbus su rdo rje rtse dgu rwa gdengs pa'i lte bar hūm̐: de yi phyir mu khyud la bsnyen sgrub dang srung sngags tshang ba: de'i phyir 'khor lo rtsibs bzhi la mdun nas brtsam ste g.yas skor du rtsibs rtser 'khor lo rin chen pad+ma ral gri rnams kyis mtshan pa: rtsibs dbus su: oṃ bud+dha siṃ ha mu kha ma ma kā wā tsi rak+ṣa rak+ṣa bh+rūm̐: de bzhin du: rat+na pad+ma karma zhes bsgyur: rtsibs mchan la e sa bh+yo srungs: zhes bri: de'i phyi rol tu 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad kyi rtser me rlung 'phro ba: dbus su mdun nas brtsams te: oṃ badz+ra siṃ hā mu khī he ma ma kā wā tsi rak+ṣa rak+ṣa bh+rūm̐: de bzhin du: byā gh+ri: sṛ la: shwa na: kṛta: kaṅka: khā kha: hu lu: zhes bsgyur ba dang rtsibs mchan la e sa bh+yo srungs bri: de rgyab mu khyud la bh+yo nyer brgyad kyi mthar dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥm ma yo gi nī ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bh+yo hūm̐ḥ dbyangs gsal rten snying gi mthar 'di 'chang ba po'i lus ngag yid gsum la nad gdon bgegs rigs byad phur rbod gtong sogs mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad rak+ṣa rak+ṣa bh+rūm̐: de rgyab rdor rwa me ris bskor: sin+dhu ra: shu dag: gi wang: gri khrag: yungs dkar: thal chen: gu gul rnams byugs: rab tu gnas la rma bya'i mdongs dang lhan cig 'chang bas rdo rje'i mkhar du tshud pa dang 'dra'o: dug khrag rdzas kyis srung ba ni: bong nga: ra dug: re lcag: thang khrom: mkhan dmar: thar nu: shog shing: mi rta khyi gsum grir shi ba'i khrag: bya rog: g.yag rgod: phag rnams kyi khrag: mngal khrag: shu dag nag po: mu zi: ru rta: gla rtsi: spru nag: gu gul: yungs dkar rnams lo brgyad dri chur sbyar la glang khyu ba'i rwa g.yas su blugs: thun snod gnam lcags kyi khang bur thun rdzas drag sngags 'dus pa'i ngo bor mos la sgrub sngags sham du:

badz+ra kī li kī la ya nā ga du ts+tshin+de ts+tshin+de mi li mi li bhan+dha bhan+dha nā ga ni swā hā: a ya ma du ru tsa sha na e hur thuṃ dza: khri'am stong gis bsgrubs pa bza' byugs bdug dang 'chang bas nad gdon bgegs rigs thams cad srung zhing zhi ba'i mchog go: snod ldan la bka' gtad na: bdag dang sgrub gtor lhar bskyed cing bsnyen sgrub bya: slob ma rgyud sbyangs nas seng gdong dam tshig par bskyed: gtor ma dbyings phyug ḍā ki seng gdong ma 'khor dang bcas pa'i ye shes kyi sku dngos su gsal ba spyi bor bzhag pa'i tshe gnas gsum las 'od zer dkar dmar mthing gsum byung: slob ma'i gnas gsum du thim pas sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub thob: mthar 'od du zhu nas dbyer med du thim pas bdud 'dul ḍā ki dngos su gyur par bsam la: spyan 'dren tshig bzhi'i mthar/ skal ldan slob ma rigs kyi bu rnams la: sku gsung thugs kyis byin gyis brlab tu gsol: ye shes lnga yi dbang mchog bskur du gsol: yon tan phrin las rdzogs par mdzad du gsol: sngags mthar kā ya wā ka tsit+ta dzñā na sarba sid+dhi ba liṃ ta a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: bzlas lung sbyin: shis brjod kyis brtan par bya'o: des bsnyen sgrub las gsum la dbang thob par 'gyur ro: 'di ni paṇ+ḍi ta chen po bi ma la mi tra la dur khrod chen po rab tu snang bar byed par ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyis dngos su gnang: rgyal po dharmā pa la'i mchod gnas mdzad pa'i tshe mu stegs kyi rgol ba nus pa can du ma rig pa chen mo 'di'i mthus bcom pa dang rjes su 'brel pa'i gdams pa shin tu zab cing gsang ba'i gsang ba ste: snying thig zab mo'i rnal 'byor pa rnams kyis gsang ba'i thugs dam du bya'o: man+t+ra gu h+ya sa ma ya: rgya rgya:
